title: Corporate Programme Bookings and Consumer Bookings under the Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
A booking made under a corporate travel programme and a consumer booking are mutually exclusive on price.

## 1. What a corporate booking does not take

In particular a corporate booking earns no club points, claims no price-drop settlement, and takes no club fee waiver, whatever the traveller's personal club tier.

## 2. Brands not eligible for a corporate discount

A fare brand that is not eligible for a corporate discount may still be sold under a programme, but at its public price, and the programme's negotiated terms do not reach it.

## 3. Adding or removing a programme reference

Where a traveller asks for a corporate reference to be added to a booking that has already been ticketed as a consumer booking, the booking is not re-priced; the programme reference is recorded for reporting only.

Where the corporate reference is removed before ticketing the booking reverts to consumer terms in full.

## 4. One reference at a time

A booking may carry at most one corporate programme reference at a time.

| The booking | What follows |
| --- | --- |
| a reference added before ticketing | the booking is a corporate booking, and section 1 governs |
| a reference added after ticketing | not re-priced; the reference is recorded for reporting only |
| a reference removed before ticketing | consumer terms in full |
| a second reference sought | not permitted; one reference at a time |

## 5. Clauses no longer in force

> "a booking that carries a corporate programme reference is priced entirely on the programme's negotiated terms"

That clause is **no longer in force**. The handling basis it stated has been superseded by the basis now governing the pricing of a booking that carries a corporate programme reference on Air Ticket Fare Brands bookings. The brand values scheduled under this policy are unaffected and stand as stated.

> "none of the consumer concessions in this charter apply to it"

That clause is **no longer in force**. The handling basis it stated has been superseded by the basis now governing the pricing of a booking that carries a corporate programme reference on Air Ticket Fare Brands bookings. The brand values scheduled under this policy are unaffected and stand as stated.

Sections 1 to 4 are unaffected by those retirements and remain in force, as does the corporate discount eligibility scheduled for each brand.

## 6. Point of judgement

**A traveller with a personal club tier books on a corporate programme.** Section 1 governs: no club points accrue, no price-drop settlement is claimed and no club fee waiver is taken, however high the personal tier stands.
